evals.prompt: Compare these two PDFs and tell me what changed: assets/samples/identical_a.pdf and assets/samples/identical_b.pdf
evals.expected_output: Documents are identical. No text, visual, or metadata changes. changed_pages should be empty.

expected_findings.finding: Agent can confirm documents are identical — nothing to flag to the user
Triage is empty so agent won't accidentally report phantom changes

evals.prompt: What's different between assets/samples/text_change_a.pdf and assets/samples/text_change_b.pdf? I want a full comparison.
evals.expected_output: Page 2 should show text_changed=true with insertions/deletions. Other pages should be unchanged. Visual change may also be detected on page 2.

expected_findings.finding: Agent can quote that 'original second page' was changed to 'REVISED second page'
Agent can note an extra line was added to page 2
Agent can confirm pages 1 and 3 are unchanged

evals.prompt: Are these identical? assets/samples/layout_change_a.pdf assets/samples/layout_change_b.pdf — I'm interested in layout differences, not just text.
evals.expected_output: Text content is the same across all pages, but visual_changed=true on pages with layout shifts. The visual score should be above threshold.

expected_findings.finding: Agent can tell user text is identical but layout differs visually
Agent can point to specific pages with visual layout changes

evals.prompt: Diff these two documents but only look at pages 1-2: assets/samples/text_change_a.pdf and assets/samples/text_change_b.pdf
evals.expected_output: Only pages 1 and 2 should appear in the report. Page 2 should show changes, page 1 should be clean.

expected_findings.finding: Agent can confirm only the requested page range was analyzed
Agent can quote the specific text changes on page 2

evals.prompt: I need to verify these revised contracts are the same as the originals. Can you check assets/samples/identical_a.pdf against assets/samples/identical_b.pdf? Just text comparison is fine.
evals.expected_output: Text-only mode comparison. Documents identical. No text changes detected.

expected_findings.finding: Agent can reassure user the contracts are identical

evals.prompt: Compare assets/samples/pagecount_3_a.pdf and assets/samples/pagecount_4_b.pdf — the second one might have extra pages.
evals.expected_output: Page count mismatch detected (3 vs 4). Smart page matching should align pages by content. Pages 1-3 should match. Page 4 should be flagged as inserted in right document with match_type 'inserted'. page_count_match should be false.

expected_findings.finding: Agent can tell user the revised doc has 1 extra page (3 vs 4)
Agent can describe what the new page contains
Agent can confirm existing pages 1-3 still match

evals.prompt: Check if there are any differences between assets/samples/metadata_only_a.pdf and assets/samples/metadata_only_b.pdf. The content should be the same but metadata might differ.
evals.expected_output: Page content is identical (text_changed=false, visual_changed=false for all pages). Metadata differences detected: Title changed from 'Draft v1' to 'Final v2', Author changed from 'Alice' to 'Bob'. summary.identical should still be true since page content hasn't changed.

expected_findings.finding: Agent can confirm page content is identical
Agent can quote the Title change: Draft v1 to Final v2
Agent can quote the Author change: Alice to Bob

evals.prompt: Compare assets/samples/middle_insert_a.pdf and assets/samples/middle_insert_b.pdf — the revised version has new sections added in the middle.
evals.expected_output: Smart page matching detects 2 inserted pages (Chapters 2a and 2b). Original pages 1,2,4,5 should match to right pages 1,2,6,7 as 'matched'. Pages 3-4 in right should be 'inserted'. Chapter 3 (left page 3 to right page 5) should show text changes. Report should include report.html.

expected_findings.finding: Agent can describe the first inserted section: Chapter 2a on supplementary methods
Agent can describe the second inserted section: Chapter 2b on data collection
Agent can explain where in the document the new pages were inserted
Agent can report that Chapter 3 was also modified

evals.prompt: Diff assets/samples/middle_delete_a.pdf against assets/samples/middle_delete_b.pdf and tell me what was removed.
evals.expected_output: Smart page matching detects 1 deleted page (Section 3: Obsolete Section). Left page 3 should have match_type 'deleted'. Section 4 should show text changes. Pages 1,2,5 should match identically. An HTML report (report.html) should be generated.

expected_findings.finding: Agent can describe what was removed: Section 3 about obsolete content
Agent can report Section 4 was modified after the deletion
Agent can confirm pages 1, 2 and 5 are unchanged

evals.prompt: Compare these PDFs and open the HTML report: assets/samples/text_change_a.pdf and assets/samples/text_change_b.pdf
evals.expected_output: Comparison should run with --open flag. HTML report (report.html) generated alongside report.json and report.md. Page 2 text changes detected. report.html is a self-contained file with inline diff images.

expected_findings.finding: Agent can quote the text changes on page 2

evals.prompt: Compare these real documents: assets/samples/real_a.pdf and assets/samples/real_b.pdf — give me a full comparison with all details.
evals.expected_output: Page count mismatch detected (47 vs 54). page_count_match should be false. Documents should be flagged as different with many changed pages. Smart page matching should detect inserted pages via match_type. Both text and visual changes found. report.html generated. visual_changes descriptions should be present for visually changed pages.

expected_findings.finding: Agent can tell user the document grew from 47 to 54 pages
Agent can quote the date change on page 1
Agent can quote the customer reference change on page 1
Agent can describe what was added in inserted pages (e.g. model data)
Cosmetic changes are grouped via patterns so agent doesn't list them per-page

evals.prompt: I just need to know what text changed between assets/samples/real_a.pdf and assets/samples/real_b.pdf — text only please.
evals.expected_output: Text-only mode comparison. Page count mismatch detected (47 vs 54). page_count_match should be false. Many pages should have text_changed=true. text_diff_lines should be present for changed pages. Visual fields should be null since mode is text.

expected_findings.finding: Agent can report the page count difference
Agent can quote the date and reference changes from text diffs

evals.prompt: Batch compare these 4 PDFs as 2 pairs.
evals.expected_output: batch_summary.json should exist with generated_at, total_pairs, overview, and pairs array. overview should have identical, substantive_changes, cosmetic_only, total_inserted_pages, total_deleted_pages. Each pair should have triage_summary with structural_count, substantive_count, cosmetic_count, structural, substantive, cosmetic_pages, global_patterns. Pair 1 should have substantive changes. Pair 2 should have inserted pages.

expected_findings.finding: Agent can summarize both pairs from batch_summary alone (without reading individual reports)
Agent can tell user Pair 1 has substantive text changes
Agent can tell user Pair 2 has new pages inserted

evals.expected_output: batch_summary.json overview.identical should be 1. Pair with identical documents should have triage_summary with all counts at 0. Non-identical pair should have substantive or structural changes.

expected_findings.finding: Agent can tell user which pair is identical and which has changes
Agent can describe the changes in the non-identical pair from triage_summary alone

evals.prompt: Compare assets/samples/text_change_a.pdf and assets/samples/text_change_b.pdf — full comparison.
evals.expected_output: Triage should classify page 2 as substantive. triage.substantive should have at least 1 entry. triage.cosmetic should be empty or small. triage.structural should be empty (same page count). report.md should exist alongside report.json.

expected_findings.finding: Agent can correctly classify page 2 as substantive (not cosmetic)
Agent won't incorrectly report structural changes (same page count)

evals.prompt: Compare assets/samples/middle_insert_a.pdf and assets/samples/middle_insert_b.pdf — what was added?
evals.expected_output: Triage structural should list inserted pages. triage.substantive should list pages with text changes. Inserted pages should have match_type inserted in triage.structural entries.

expected_findings.finding: Agent can list which pages are new from triage.structural
Agent can describe content of inserted pages to tell user what was added
Agent can distinguish structural (new pages) from substantive (modified pages)
